detail: Wave four: T-159 (Anggota in the settings pattern + whole-admin screening, two real a11y defects fixed: a 1.41:1 destructive focus ring and a 2.57:1 stepper label), T-165/T-166 (Laporan pengiriman with CSV export, Riwayat cetak resi), T-169 (Mengantar delivery states now move the lifecycle via the manual settlement pull; nothing maps to IN_TRANSIT because no in-transit value was observed), T-173 (courier catalogue taken from the provider; spx was missing and iDexpressCargo was recapped as its own courier), plus the T-153 provider contract capture. Independent review returned PASS with four should-fixes, all taken: a tautological outlet predicate on the lifecycle write whose guard asserted its SQL text, a refused-transition count shown to nobody, an outcome vocabulary unbound to 0047's CHECK literal, and a report CSV whose body was hand-positional beside a derived header. Report columns are now bound to docs/spec/19. tsc and ESLint clean, 109 files / 1085 tests, twelve browser audits green including a 22-route x 4-width screening sweep with zero findings, migration upgrade verifier through 0047, developer database at 48 migrations with business data unchanged.
